name: Turbomachinery control systems
principle: Turbomachinery controllers run the fast, dedicated loops that protect and optimise machines: speed and load control on turbines, surge avoidance on compressors (recycle valves and setpoint margins sized from the compressor map), load sharing between machines, and sequence control for start-up and shutdown. The control system responds in tens of milliseconds — faster than the DCS loop layer — and coordinates with the SIS on trip circuits. Integrated machinery packages ship with controllers tuned to the OEM's model, and online performance monitoring feeds optimisation.

process_steps.name: Speed, load or process demand tracked by fast control loops
Surge control holds operating point off the compressor surge line
Load sharing and sequencing across parallel machines
Start-up, shutdown and purge sequences executed

suppliers.name: GE Vernova
suppliers.product: Bently Nevada machinery control and protection

limitations: surge margin tuning is compressor-specific and re-verified after every re-rate or re-wheel
anti-surge control interacts with process control; both need joint tuning, not sequential
advantages: prevents surge events that mechanically destroy compressors in seconds
dedicated fast hardware keeps control deterministic where DCS loops cannot
